observations: All four native heroes show a coherent tall fan of substantial folded leaves with pointed tips, broad lime planes, readable darker green faces and softly treated edges. This is a clear volumetric improvement over the original thin planar foliage and exposed upright stems.

The square tapered orange-brown pot and rounded golden rim preserve the original identity while visibly moving toward the target's warm soft cartoon treatment. The opening is dark warm brown, rather than a black defect; its edge and the foliage crown remain separable at logical size.

The four heroes were inspected at native 384x768 resolution and at 192x384 logical size on light, midgray and dark backgrounds. No clipped tips, unwanted ground shadow, fringe halo, exposed geometry ends or material dead patch is visible.

Every frame of each packet-bound idle GIF was decoded and inspected in temporal order through independently generated logical-size contact sheets, together with the supplied full motion sheet. Foliage moves subtly without detached leaves, overlap popping or a conspicuous closing-frame discontinuity; the pot silhouette stays fixed. Timing is a repeated 80/80/90ms sequence totaling exactly one second for 12 unique frames.

Static captures retain the same geometry/material style as the idle. Across S/E/N/W, the fan has plausible changes of overlap while its lighting treatment remains consistent; no facing has a visibly broken or unreadable side.
remainingDifferences: The native fan has narrower central upright leaves and a cleaner, more regular arrangement than the single-view painted target. The fixed criteria allow this coherent native variation.

Lime planes are somewhat yellower, the rim less orange, and the pot opening darker than in the target. They retain readable green/gold/brown separation and the requested warm soft treatment at intended size, so these differences are non-blocking.
Target glow/halos and painterly distortions are intentionally absent.
